visualCharacteristics.purpose: Photo-background banner with a text column (heading, paragraph, button, large stats) and a looping video at the side
observed: Background photo; h2 "For Texas, For the Future" + paragraph + CTA "See Our Impact on Texas" + stats; looping video at right

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading, paragraph, CTA link, stat paragraphs (**value** label) and a link to the video file (.mp4) — the video link may also sit in its own cell with an optional poster image
notes: Text over a photo background: the photo belongs to its block (hero), so the section is not colored; the side video and stats are part of the same banner.

usage: Closing or outro banner pairing a message and figures with ambient video.
reuseGuidance: Use for text plus side video over a photo; for a headline-only photo hero use hero-headline.
